t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The previous player is telling me to always pick with the same side. With there being two gnomes, there will always be a 50/50 chance of picking the side with the most mushrooms.It doesn't really matter what I pick, I will always have the same chance of a goal/nogoal

vb_textbox.text: To be honest, there doesn't seem to be a strategy to this game. I've tried different methods and I usually get the same results.The best round I had is when I alternated between the gnomes (Left, to right, to left again etc.), every now and then, I went for the same gnome three times in a row (L, R, L, L, L, R, L, R, L, R, R, R etc). I got around 1000 points during this round. Feel free to do your own way though. It genuinely seems like its 50/50.
